title: refactor(Formalism/PolynomialDimension): remove duplicated MonoCount helpers from TieOps
body:
Remove 65 duplicated declarations (and one duplicated `DecidablePred (fsj N r j0)` instance) from `TieOps.lean` (`Formalism.CountingSumsFrames.TO`) that match identical definitions and theorems already imported from `MonoCount.lean` in the parent namespace `Formalism.CountingSumsFrames` (plus two private helper lemmas only used by the duplicated `whc_comm`), keeping `sl_isF` from the replaced range, and update the single caller of `TO.Cset` in `LatticeTheoremEps28Valid.lean` to use `Cset`.

Removed declarations in `Formalism.CountingSumsFrames.TO` (all except the two private `whc_*` helpers are reused directly from `Formalism.CountingSumsFrames` in `MonoCount.lean`):
- `proj_exists`
- `frst`, `ltr`, `IsF`, `IsL`, `frst_add_ltr`, `frst_of`, `ltr_of`, `frst_of'`, `ltr_of'`, `frst_add`, `ltr_add`, `frst_isF`, `ltr_isL`
- `ext`, `slc`, `monomial_eq_basis`, `ext_monomial`, `sl_monomial`, `ext_mul`, `sl_mul`, `ext_eq_sum`, `eq_sum_sl`, `isL_monomial_ltr`, `isF_monomial_frst`, `monomial_split`
- `fsj`, anonymous `DecidablePred (fsj N r j0)` instance, `wlat`, `wfir`, `weight_eq_zero_iff`, `isF_iff`, `isL_iff`, `glAct_isF`, `glAct_isL`, `midAct_isF`, `killL_of_isL`, `slc_glAct`, `weight_wv_zero`, `slc_wh`
- `slc_ycond`, `slc_pol`, `isF_of_polLz`, `mul_ltr_pol`, `midAct_eq`, `midAct_isL`, `midAct_mul_F`, `ext_glAct`, `weight_first`, `wh_first`, `ext_wh`
- `Mup`, `Cset`, `slc_C`, `ext_Y`, `psi`, `psi_mem`, `psi_id`, `whc_same_lemma`, `whc_ne_lemma_2`, `whc_comm`, `whc_keep`, `psi_glAct`, `C_stable`, `polynomial_finite_weights`, `Y_fd`
